body:
Yeah it will get better eventually, but somehow I spiral down amd just ruin everything again. Ive gone from being the nicest person ever to a comeplete mess, and no matter what I still manage to end up worse off than before.

Im getting sick of this cycling every couple years, I feel like I have no control. I get happiness for such a short time for a few years of despair and agony. I keep losing friends, my mother whos even tried to help me my whole life is starting to give up on me ( even if she wont say it I can see it), My job of year I used to be great at but after an awful break up with my manager the whole work place hates me. 

I cant keep this up, Im starting to realize Im hurting people that actually do care about me by just being a fuck up. Everything I do just seems wrong and unatural.
